### Strategy

1. Iterate over Fastq files (1, 2, 3, 4, 5,)

2. Pull the ID for each file

```{r}
results <- data.frame()

for (fastq_id in unique(dat$FastQ)){
  # subset the file's keys and IDs
  tmp_frame <- dat[dat$FastQ == fastq_id,]
  cat("Loading: ", files[[fastq_id]], '\n', sep = '')
  # load the fastq file
  tmp <- readFastq(paste(root_dir, files[[fastq_id]], sep = ''))
  # Pull the keys
  ids <- as.data.frame(id(tmp))
  # Pull the sequences
  seqs <- as.data.frame(sread(tmp))
  # Bind them
  tmp <- as.data.frame(cbind(ids, seqs))
  colnames(tmp) <- c("ID", "sequence")
  
  # Pull original data
  tmp_res_one <- dat[which(dat$ID %in% tmp$ID),]
  cat(nrow(tmp_res_one)/nrow(tmp_frame)*100, "% of sequences located.\n", sep = '')
  # Pull sequence data
  tmp_res_two <- tmp[which(tmp$ID %in% dat$ID),]
  tmp_res <- merge(tmp_res_one, tmp_res_two, by = "ID")
  tmp_res$file <- rep(files[[fastq_id]], each = nrow(tmp_res))
  results <- rbind(results, tmp_res)
}
```


```{r}
tmp <- ShortRead::readFasta("~/VHH/data/DNA_Query_seqs12Mar24.fasta")
# Pull the keys
ids <- as.data.frame(id(tmp))
# Pull the sequences
seqs <- as.data.frame(sread(tmp))
# Bind them
tmp <- as.data.frame(cbind(ids, seqs))
colnames(tmp) <- c("Construct", "true_sequence")
```


```{r}
test <- merge(results,tmp, by = "Construct", all.x = T)
```

```{r}
homology <- vector()
for (i in 1:nrow(test)){
  homology <- c(homology, 100 - (as.vector(adist(test$sequence[i], test$true_sequence[i]))/nchar(test$sequence[i]))*100)
}
test$homology <- homology
```

## Writing as raw Fastq

```{r}
for (fastq_id in unique(dat$FastQ)){
  # subset the file's keys and IDs
  tmp_frame <- dat[dat$FastQ == fastq_id,]
  cat("Loading: ", files[[fastq_id]], '\n', sep = '')
  # load the fastq file
  tmp <- readFastq(paste(root_dir, files[[fastq_id]], sep = ''))
  fastq_entries <- tmp[which(id(tmp) %in% dat[dat$FastQ == fastq_id,]$ID),]
  writeFastq(fastq_entries, file = "~/Downloads/VHH-DNA-Queries14Apr24.fastq", mode = 'a', compress = F)
}
```
